import sys
from collections import defaultdict

# Helper functions for modular arithmetic
MOD = 1000000007
INV = 570000004

def add_mod(a, b):
    res = a + b
    return res - MOD if res >= MOD else res

def sub_mod(a, b):
    res = a - b
    return res + MOD if res < 0 else res

def mul_mod(a, b):
    return (a * b) % MOD

# Bitset class to mimic C++ bitset<128>
class Bitset:
    def __init__(self, value=0):
        self.bits = 0
        if isinstance(value, int):
            self.bits = value
        elif isinstance(value, Bitset):
            self.bits = value.bits

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        return (self.bits >> index) & 1

    def __setitem__(self, index, value):
        if value:
            self.bits |= (1 << index)
        else:
            self.bits &= ~(1 << index)

    def __or__(self, other):
        result = Bitset()
        result.bits = self.bits | other.bits
        return result

    def __and__(self, other):
        result = Bitset()
        result.bits = self.bits & other.bits
        return result

    def __lshift__(self, shift):
        result = Bitset()
        result.bits = (self.bits << shift) & ((1 << 128) - 1)
        return result

    def __rshift__(self, shift):
        result = Bitset()
        result.bits = self.bits >> shift
        return result

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return self.bits == other.bits

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash(self.bits)

    def set(self, index):
        self.bits |= (1 << index)

    def reset(self, index):
        self.bits &= ~(1 << index)

    def count(self):
        return bin(self.bits).count('1')

    def __len__(self):
        return 128

    def __repr__(self):
        return bin(self.bits)

# Read input
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
pos = 1

index_map = dict()
children = dict()
node_id = 0
time_idx = 0

def dfs(s):
    global node_id, time_idx
    if s in index_map:
        return index_map[s]
    id_ = time_idx
    index_map[s] = id_
    time_idx += 1
    children[id_] = [0] * (1 << node_id)
    for mask in range(1 << node_id):
        new_s = Bitset(s)
        for j in range(node_id):
            if not new_s[j]:
                k_mask = mask & (1 << j)
                k = k_mask
                while k:
                    k_lowbit = k & -k
                    j_xor = j ^ (k_lowbit.bit_length() - 1)
                    if s[j_xor]:
                        new_s.set(j)
                        break
                    k ^= k_lowbit
        children[id_][mask] = dfs(new_s)
    return id_

# Initialize with empty bitset
initial_bitset = Bitset(0)
index_map[initial_bitset] = 0
node_id = 1
time_idx = 1
dfs(initial_bitset)

# Read matrix p
p = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        p[i][j] = int(input[pos])
        pos += 1
        p[i][j] = mul_mod(p[i][j], INV)

# Precompute q
q = [[1]*(1 << n) for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(1 << n):
        q[i][j] = 1
        for k in range(n):
            val = p[k][i] if (j >> k) & 1 else sub_mod(1, p[k][i])
            q[i][j] = mul_mod(q[i][j], val)

# Initialize DP array
dp = [[0]*(time_idx) for _ in range(n+1)]
dp[0][0] = 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(time_idx):
        if dp[i][j] != 0:
            for k in range(1 << n):
                next_state = children[j][k]
                dp[i+1][next_state] = add_mod(dp[i+1][next_state], mul_mod(dp[i][j], q[i][k]))

# Construct result bitset with all bits set
res = Bitset()
for i in range(128):
    res.set(i)

# Output the result
print(dp[n][index_map[res]])
